M Mr Gole Mr Gole. Approved. 2026

Mr Gole is a food and travel vlogger who brings the flavours, culture and stories of every place he visits to life across YouTube, Instagram and TikTok. The goal: strengthen his identity as a food and travel creator.

A simple, bold Mr Gole. wordmark, with the full stop making the name feel finished and brand ready. Yellow and black give instant contrast, and blue balances it with calm.

Stickers, takeaway packaging, caps and social templates that mix English and Nepali to reach a wider audience.
